about_content:
🏓 Transcendence — Online Multiplayer Pong Game

Transcendence is a modernized version of the classic Pong game, designed for a smooth, competitive, and social online experience. It includes tournaments, a friends system, and a multilingual interface.

⚙️ Technologies Used
	Frontend: React, TypeScript, WebSocket, TailwindCSS
	Backend: TypeScript, Fastify
	WebSocket: for real-time gameplay and chat
	Authentication: 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication), Google OAuth
	Docker: for container deployment

🧩 Game Description
The game is played 1v1 online. Each player controls a paddle and tries to score points.

	Online matches
	Single-elimination tournaments
	Global ranking

🕹️ Game Controls
Move paddle up	↑ or W
Move paddle down	↓ or S

💡 Main Features
	🎮 Real-time multiplayer via WebSocket
	🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Friends system
	🏆 Tournament organization
	🔒 2FA and Google OAuth authentication
	🌐 Multilingual interface: French 🇫🇷, English 🇬🇧, Japanese 🇯🇵
	👤 Customizable profiles
	📸 Profile picture update
	✏️ Change username

🔐 Secure Logout
	The Logout button at the top right allows you to safely sign out.

🌍 Language Selector
	Allows dynamic switching of interface language.

🔐 Google Login
	A temporary username like guess_0 is automatically assigned.
	Default password: "default". Can be personalized later.
